skill.summary: Monitors and optimizes AI API usage costs across multiple providers

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of skylv-cost-guard.
- Monitors and optimizes AI API costs across OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.
- Tracks token usage, compares provider pricing, and sets customizable budget alerts.
- Provides actionable optimization and savings suggestions.
- Integrates with OpenClaw for easy queries and cost comparisons.
